Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low total protein, suggesting possible infection, inflammation, or bone marrow suppression. There is also monocytosis, basophilia, and elevated RDW and alkaline phosphatase, which may indicate underlying chronic disease or reactive changes. No evidence of COVID-19 RNA detected. Recommend clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying causes, including infection, hematologic, or hepatic disorders.
